initial_plan.can_answer: partly: the file can compare annual pedestrian deaths in Brooklyn-reported crashes, but it cannot measure individual pedestrian risk or exposure-adjusted safety
initial_plan.population: pedestrians killed in police-reported crashes whose borough is Brooklyn and whose crash date is in 2013 or later
initial_plan.years: each calendar year from 2013 through the latest year present

data_check.rows_and_years: The planned Brooklyn population has 483,501 crash rows from 2013 onward. 2013-2025 each have observed dates from January 1 through December 31; 2026 has 9,700 rows only through June 11, 2026.
data_check.column_quality: Among the planned population, borough and crash_date are not missing; number_of_pedestrians_killed has no missing or negative values and is zero in 483,119 rows. Zero means no pedestrian death reported in that crash and is not treated as missing.
data_check.decision: Use only complete calendar years 2013-2025 and exclude the 9,700 rows from partial 2026 (2.0% of Brooklyn rows from 2013 onward). Keep zero values as zero; no otherwise eligible rows are excluded for missing or impossible death counts.
data_check.change: Narrowed the initial through-latest-year plan to complete calendar years through 2025 because 2026 coverage ends on June 11.

final_plan.can_answer: partly: annual counts of pedestrians killed in Brooklyn police-reported crashes can be compared, but exposure-adjusted pedestrian safety cannot be measured
final_plan.denominator: none; raw count of reported pedestrian deaths
final_plan.population: pedestrians reported killed in crashes with borough Brooklyn and crash dates in complete calendar years 2013-2025
final_plan.limitations: Counts cover police-reported crashes, not pedestrian exposure or risk; borough and outcome reporting may be incomplete. The data check finds 2026 ends June 11, so 9,700 otherwise matching partial-year crash rows (2.0% of the 2013-onward Brooklyn population) are excluded; there are no missing or negative death counts, and valid zeros are retained.
